tagline: A smart Quran memorization circle management system
access_code_hint: Type the code your teacher gave you — three letters then three digits
access_code_renew_hint: The code does not change until you renew it. Renew it about once a month, or if the student loses it.
i_am_student: I am a student — sign in with a code
i_am_staff: I am a teacher or supervisor — sign in with email
circles_subtitle: The System Administrator creates circles and assigns a supervisor to each one. Teachers, students and everything recorded about them belong to the circle supervisor.
name: Name
circle_admins_subtitle: These are the people the System Administrator deals with. Each circle has one supervisor, who manages its teachers and students.
confirm_delete_session: Delete this session? Its notes are deleted with it.
delete_blocked_hint: A record with recorded sessions cannot be deleted. Suspend it instead, so the student's history stays intact.
audit_subtitle: Every addition, edit and deletion is recorded here and cannot be erased.
settings_note: These values control how a student's level, memorization pace and encouragement points are calculated. They are provisional and are tuned against real data; change them only after study.
setting_d_max_hint: The number of mistakes per page at which the level reads zero. Raising it makes marking gentler, lowering it makes it stricter.
setting_alpha_hint: How much the most recent week counts towards the memorization pace, against the weeks before it. Between 0 and 1.
setting_xp_per_page_hint: Encouragement points a student earns for each page memorized.
setting_xp_per_session_hint: Encouragement points a student earns for attending a session.
roster_subtitle: This is where the circle supervisor registers teachers and students and edits their details.
password_optional_hint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
no_teachers_yet: No teacher has been registered in this circle yet.
no_students_yet: No student has been registered in this circle yet.
needs_attention_hint: Students whose level has slipped or whose attendance has dropped recently.
all_good: No student needs urgent follow-up right now.
mastery_hint: Out of 100 — the fewer mistakes a student makes per page, the higher it climbs.
momentum_hint: Average number of pages the student memorizes in a week.
precision_hint: Share of notes that were minor — the higher it is, the fewer serious mistakes.
consistency_hint: How often the student attended the last eight sessions.
review_depth_hint: Pages the student reviews for every new page memorized.
trend_hint: The line rises as the student covers more pages with fewer mistakes, and falls when performance slips.
leaderboard_note: Four separate lists. A student who does not lead one may well lead another — there is no single combined ranking.
attendance_subtitle: Pick the day, then set each student's status. No need to open the recitation form.
tap_to_tag: Tap a note type to add it
session_saved: Session saved and the student's figures updated
queued_offline: No connection — the session was saved on this device and will be sent when the network returns
forecast_stale: The forecast could not be refreshed just now — this is the last stored one
forecast_none: More sessions are needed before a date can be estimated
cond_MASTERY_MIN: Reach a level of {n} out of 100
account_subtitle: Edit your own details and password. What you change here appears with your circle supervisor straight away.
passwords_do_not_match: The two passwords do not match
share_help: The guardian receives a private link that opens the student's full performance report as a PDF. It needs no account, it expires, and it can be revoked at any time.
share_no_phone: No guardian phone number is on file. Add one to the student's details first.
eval_note: The system compares the current forecasting method with alternatives on held-out data. The target is for 80% of forecasts to land within two weeks of the actual date — a target to measure, not a proven result.
eval_split: Split by student, never by row
